  clr_country_flag = ctc_cp_event_open

hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = ctc_cp_CRO_common_1_administration_1_settled add_political_power = 5

 subtract_from_variable = { ctc_cp_delta = ctc_cp_CRO_common_1_administration_1_credit }

 }
